name: Narugino Mikatan
source:
A member of the idol group "Seas May", who secretly fights crime as the magical girl Strange Juice. Whenever she is flustered or alone, she ends up speaking in the Tsugaru dialect which she picked up in her early childhood. When the characters in her name are read differently, her name is a pun on the phrase "ally of justice" (正義の味方 seigi no mikata).

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Punch_Line_(anime)]Wikipedia[/url]]
